runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 10.9.2026 10:39 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new unique promotion-grade hit cleared the full location/language/skill/economics gate. FINAL-CD Opel service assistant is BA-area and relevant but requires B1 English, two years similar experience plus advanced Office/accounting knowledge. Persea and Kanadevia were rejected for stronger English/experience requirements. LinkedIn remote results were student-only or language-heavy. Upwork results were mostly low-budget or development-heavy. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts; coverage remains limited.

sources.name: Profesia
